rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. The No branch reads “Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a” (i1040gi p. 38). When Schedule D is not required, line 7a carries the total capital gain distributions from Form 1099-DIV box 2a (i1040gi p. 33, line 7a, Exception 1), which is the value the project references directly (`sd.distributions`); the second transcription references line 7a literally. No change to the data.
